Synopsis:
The dialogue is triggeredin 2 cases:- when players cure Mayrina cursed by the hag spy. It is very unhappy that his curse was lifted and starts  combat with players.- when players destroy the voodoo doll and Mayrina is not in the cityWe need this dialogue so hag spy has a chance to explain that it was him behind Mayrina's curse.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_HagSurvivors_HagSpy_Aggroed.json: The party has confronted a hag-survivor camp after a bewitched voodoo doll was found tormenting the hags; a redcap impostor is disguised as one of their number and has been acting as a spy among them. If Mayrina was present she was hexed into a sheep by that doll; if she wasn’t, the doll merely popped up to frighten the survivors. The redcap spy is cold and accusatory, his disguise imperfect (the narrator notes he “smells of blood and moss”), and he sent the doll — but he will try to deflect blame onto the player to hide his role. This dialogue fires either when the players cure Mayrina (breaking the hex) or when they destroy the doll while Mayrina is absent, and the spy reacts angrily, threatens to defend “Auntie Ethel” and may provoke combat while claiming the players seek the hag’s book.
- LOW_HagSurvivors_SurrogateMother_SheepForm.json: The dialogue in which players speak in Mayrina while she is in sheep form due to a curse from hag spy.
- LOW_HagSurvivors_HagSpy.json: A redcap in hag disguise has been planted among the hag survivors as a spy. He sent a bewitched doll that taunts and scares the others — if Mayrina is present the doll was used to hex her into a sheep; if she isn’t, it merely pops up to torment the survivors. The spy is cold, accusatory, and tries to deflect blame onto the player to hide his role in the doll’s mischief. The narrator’s note that he looks like one of the hags but “smells of blood and moss” hints that his disguise is imperfect. The player has arrived either to investigate or to help Mayrina and is being watched and questioned by this suspicious spy.
- LOW_HagSurvivors_DisguisedJatloInstaDied.json: Dialog between survivors gathered around a dead hag spy, Jatlo. Happens when the hag is killed before players have triggered combat with the spy.Mayrina and Mask of Regret are optional speakers.
- LOW_HagSurvivors_SurrogateMother_Cured.json: Dialogue with Mayrina after she is cured from the hag curse. In the dialogue she gives hag research book that makes hag fight easier (there is the scroll of Burning Pearls inside), provides her husband reactivity based on how players handled him in Act 1 and may give players the quest reward for killing the hag

context: The party has arrived at a hag‑survivor camp after a bewitched voodoo doll was found tormenting the hags; a redcap impostor disguised as one of their number has been acting as a spy and sent the doll. If Mayrina was present she was hexed into a sheep by that doll; if she wasn’t, the doll merely popped up to frighten the survivors. This dialogue triggers when the players either cure Mayrina or destroy the doll while she is absent, and it gives the spy a chance to react — angrily defend “Auntie Ethel,” deflect blame onto the players, and claim they seek the hag’s book. The spy’s disguise is imperfect (the narrator notes he “smells of blood and moss”), and he will threaten the party and may provoke combat to protect the hag.
